title: 第二十一章 鹬蚌相争渔翁得利第二十二章 黑吃黑
content_zh:
水月站在最前列，环视了一圈聚拢过来的十多号人。
“此番诸位师兄弟能应妾身的邀约，妾身感激不尽，在此先行谢过了。”
说完，她朝众人行了一礼，腰身弯得恰到好处，不卑不亢。
这一礼行得漂亮。
在场的男修，有大半的目光都往她领口那片白皙上瞟了一眼，又赶紧收回来。
“实不相瞒，这次妾身发现了一座前人留下的洞府，但奈何妾身实力不够，那洞府外设有阵法守护，实在无力攻破。”
水月直起身子，语气诚恳。
“所以这才找上诸位师兄弟，合力破阵，平分洞内收获。大家或许也听过，妾身是万宝仙楼的一员，信誉这一块，还是能保证的，必然不会让诸位吃亏。”
万宝仙楼。
这四个字一出，底下那些弟子的眼珠子都亮了。
万宝仙楼是宗门内部最大的交易行，专做灵石、丹药、法器买卖，能在里面挂上号的修士，手里多少都有些路子。
这女修说自己是万宝仙楼的人，可信度一下拔高了不止一个档次。
更要命的是水月这张脸。
她站在那里，白衣素裙，五官精致，说话时眼角带着三分笑意，声音又软又糯，从头到尾没半个字提过“拿命拼”这三个字，但字里行间透出来的意思就一个：跟我走，稳赚不赔。
再加上身旁那位周前辈适时地插了两句嘴。
“老夫在外门蹉跎了二十多年，什么大风大浪没见过？水月姑娘的人品，老夫担保得了。”
这一唱一和，比唱戏还顺溜。
十几号人当场就被安排得明明白白。
贪婪是人的本性，修仙者也不例外。
众人纷纷起身，化作流光遁入高空。

万骨宗所在的‘望天云泽’占地广袤，云海翻涌，一眼望不到边际。十几道遁光穿云破雾，足足飞了一刻钟，才在一处云海前停留下来。
“就是此处了。”
水月抬手，真气裹着掌风拨开下方翻滚的云层。
云海裂开。
一座山峰从云底冒了出来，峰体呈黛青色，形如苍龙盘卧，山腰处建着数座已经残破的殿宇，隐约可见昔年的恢弘气象。
灵气虽然稀薄，但峰顶仍有一层淡淡的光幕笼着，那是阵法还未完全消散的残余。
“此地名为瀛洲岛。”水月主动开口，“昔日同门真传风玄子的洞府。外围的护府大阵原本是筑基级别的，多年无人维护，依仗的地脉早已干涸，威力十不足一。”
她顿了顿，扫了在场众人一眼。
“诸位，还请一同破阵。”
话音没落，周前辈已经率先纵身跃下，灰白的身影裹着一道暗淡的灵光，直扑瀛洲岛而去。
有人带头，其余弟子自然不甘落后。
一道、两道、三道……十几道遁光接连没入云层下方，落向那座沉寂已久的孤岛。
空中只剩下水月一人。
content_en:
Shuiyue stood at the forefront and looked around at the dozen or so people who had gathered.
"I am deeply grateful to you brothers for accepting my invitation this time. I would like to thank you in advance."
After saying that, she bowed to everyone, bending her waist just right, neither humble nor overbearing.
This was a beautiful ceremony.
Most of the male cultivators present glanced at the fair skin at her neckline, and then quickly looked away.
"To be honest, this time I discovered a cave left by my predecessors, but I am not strong enough. There is a formation guarding the cave, so I am unable to break through it."
Shuiyue straightened up and spoke sincerely.
"That's why I approached all my brothers and sisters, worked together to break the formation, and share the harvest in the cave equally. You may have heard that I am a member of the Wanbao Immortal Tower, so my reputation can be guaranteed, and I will definitely not let you suffer any loss."
Wanbao Immortal Tower.
As soon as these four words came out, the eyes of the disciples below all lit up.
Wanbao Immortal Tower is the largest trading house within the sect, specializing in the sale of spiritual stones, elixirs, and magical instruments. The monks who can be registered in it have some tricks.
This female cultivator said that she was from Wanbao Immortal Tower, and her credibility was raised by more than one level.
What's even more terrible is Shuiyue's face.
She stood there, in white clothes and plain skirt, with delicate features. When she spoke, there was a smile in the corner of her eyes, and her voice was soft and waxy. From the beginning to the end, she never mentioned the three words "risk your life", but the meaning between the lines was just one: follow me, and you will make a profit without losing anything.
In addition, Senior Zhou next to him intervened at the right time.
"I have spent more than twenty years in the outside world. What storms and waves have I not seen? I can vouch for Miss Shuiyue's character."
This singing and harmony is smoother than singing an opera.
More than a dozen people were clearly arranged on the spot.
Greed is human nature, and immortal cultivators are no exception.
Everyone stood up one after another and turned into streams of light and escaped into the sky.
The ‘Wangtian Yunze’ where the Ten Thousand Bones Sect is located occupies a vast area, with a sea of ​​clouds surging, and you can’t see the edge at a glance. More than a dozen rays of escaping light penetrated the clouds and mist, and flew for a full quarter of an hour before stopping in front of a sea of ​​clouds.
"This is it."
Shuiyue raised her hand, and the wind in her palm pushed away the rolling clouds below.
The sea of ​​clouds split.
A mountain peak emerged from the bottom of the clouds. The peak was dark blue and shaped like a dragon lying on its back. There were several dilapidated temples built on the mountainside, and the grandeur of the past could be vaguely seen.
Although the spiritual energy is thin, there is still a faint light curtain covering the peak, which is the remnant of the formation that has not completely dissipated.
"This place is called Yingzhou Island." Shui Yue took the initiative to speak, "It used to be the cave of Feng Xuanzi, the true disciple of the same sect. The outer palace protection formation was originally at the foundation level. It has not been maintained for many years. The ground veins it relies on have long dried up, and its power is less than ten."
She paused and glanced at everyone present.
"Everyone, please break the formation together."
As soon as he finished speaking, Senior Zhou took the lead and jumped down. His gray figure was wrapped in a dim aura and headed straight for Yingzhou Island.
If someone takes the lead, the rest of the disciples will naturally not be far behind.
One, two, three... more than a dozen rays of light disappeared under the clouds one after another, falling towards the long-silent island.
Suigetsu was the only one left in the sky.
